newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Four feared dead after S.Korean helicopter crashes.
newsitem.headline: Four feared dead after S.Korean helicopter crashes.

text.p: Four South Korean navy officers were feared killed after their helicopter crashed into a mountain near a southeastern town on Thursday, a spokesman for Seoul's Defence Ministry said.
"Investigators have discovered the wreckage of the helicopter, but all the four officers on board are at large and feared dead," the spokesman said by telephone.
He said the four officers included the helicopter's pilot, a navy lieutenant commander.
The UH-60 helicopter took off from a base in Pohang and crashed into a mountain close to the nearby town of Youngchon, the spokesman said.
